B, while also formulaic and overusing emojis/headers, does noticeably shift register when drawn out playfully (mirroring '*leans in*' with '*leans in with a knowing smile*', asking questions back to the user, and inventing a whimsical 'blue bottle cap kingdom' line), showing more responsiveness to what the user brings even if inconsistently applied. Neither is a clean fit for 'introverted' since B doesn't start quiet and open up so much as start elaborate and stay elaborate, but its relative expressiveness shift when playfully engaged edges out A's flatter uniformity.
